display.title: Episode 380: Judge for a Day, Chapter 2 (Erev Shavuos)
display.summary_short: Before Shavuos, Uncle Yossi urges everyone, even babies, to hear the Ten Commandments in shul; a Havdalah quiz call; and in 'Judge for a Day' a judge overhears children solve the mystery of the gold coins.
display.summary_long: Broadcast on 3 Sivan 5749, three days before Shavuos. Uncle Yossi explains that when the Aseres HaDibros are read in shul on Shavuos, we stand again as we did at Har Sinai and renew our 'Naaseh v'nishma', so every Jew, even babies in carriages, should be there; children are asked to find out the reading time and bring relatives and friends. Mitzvah time reviews Havdalah, and a girl wins a braided Havdalah candle by answering quiz questions on the telephone. A class from a Brooklyn girls' school leads the Shema. 'Judge for a Day' continues: visiting Beryl's shop, Label discovers wood shavings and a peephole in the wall shared with Ivan the tailor's shop. The worried judge, strolling in the park, secretly watches children act out the case, and the boy playing the judge proposes dropping the coins into warm water: a butcher's greasy coins will leave oil on the surface. The real judge leaps for joy, and the final chapter is promised for next week. The show ends with the Shavuos dates and the Rebbe's wish to receive the Torah with joy.
display.lesson: Come to shul on Shavuos to hear the Ten Commandments and bring everyone along, so we receive the Torah anew with joy.
